sources.title: 邱維屏《紫微斗數五行日局解》 in 1837-family 邱邦士文集 juan2 received digital transcription
sources.provider: Shidian CADAL02116090 received digital text and Dao Guang 17 preface/contents
sources.quality_notes: Early-Qing attributed author; 1837 is reprint-family preface year not proof of composition/initial publication. CADAL OCR/transcription may be defective. No physical leaf image digest or source-level stemma. This and 1875 are potentially two witnesses of one work, not two independent ancient inventions.

sources.title: 邱邦士文集 1875 Zhou Yuwen reprint juan2 五行日局解/滴天髓論己土解 digital surrogate
sources.provider: Wikimedia hosted NLC892-GBZX0301013779-271104/271105 National Library of China scan
sources.quality_notes: Volume1 digital surrogate's preface/contents report Guangxu year1 Spring; volume2 contains both Ziwei and Ditiansui essays. Web PDF page screenshot failed because file >34MB; scanned bytes/page hash and native glyph cannot be asserted. Received PDF text and auto descriptions are fallible.

sources.title: 俞樾 游藝錄卷五 紫微斗數篇 in 春在堂全書 scanned received version
sources.provider: Shidian CADAL01025514 text cross-read with NLC892-GBZX0301010898-252714 Spring in Hall anthology vol97 digital PDF
sources.quality_notes: A received text reports 木-纳音 followed by 水三局, while PDF digital description transcribes 木三局; document as unresolved OCR/variant, not historical glyph adjudication. The original scan was too large for web screenshot, no hash. Publication date 1877 from later publisher description not verified physical imprint date of accessed volume.

edges_rejected_or_unproved: Same five-bureau day-stems or position table does not prove direct Qiu->Yu borrowing or early-Ming/Song stemma
Author's dating before 1679 is not the date of an attested physical Ziwei original
Parallel Qiu Ditiansui and Yu Bazi/Ziwei chapters document reception, not one cross-disciplinary algorithm
unresolved_lineage_questions: Obtain and compare 1837 and 1875 actual leaf images and target text, including Shui/Mu and star-table variants
Verify 1877 original Youyilu imprint and later Chun Zai Tang production identity
Seek explicit Qiu quotation by Yu or shared source with identical distinctive passages
Locate pre-Ming Ziwei technical original, especially Joseon 1430 text and Eulhae print source scope
